title: Online collaboration
intro: Each Observanda installation can host its own shared books. Connect directly over your network or VPN; the hosting installation must stay open and unlocked.
hostHelp: Host on a trusted local network or VPN. Choose the interfaces to listen on and an address reachable by your collaborators. All network interfaces also include public interfaces if this computer has them; restrict the chosen port in your firewall. Observanda encrypts the connection and verifies each enrolled member. Internet-facing hosting has not been qualified.
verify: I verified this identity with the owner through a separate channel
connectHelp: Complete organization enrollment first. Ask the owner for a connection card for your member or team grant.
invalidFile: Choose a valid Observanda connection card.
empty: There are no records in this selection.
readSnapshot: This is a saved record from the host. Refresh to see newer changes; unsaved edits stay in the editing form.
creationHelp: Choose a type from the host’s lab book. The new record starts as a private draft. After creating it, write its summary and sections together.
creationPendingHelp: This creation request is retained on this installation. Retry to find out whether the host saved it. Retrying the same request creates only one record, even after restarting Observanda.
creationRejected: The host could not create this record. Review the current record types and your values before sending a revised request.
creationRemoved: The host had created this record, but it has since been removed. It was not recreated.
creationSaved: Record created on the host. You can now write together.
finishConnectionForm: Finish or cancel the open collaboration form before leaving. Pending creation requests are retained locally for retry.
detailsHelp: Save these details and template values when ready. Changes to the same field are reviewed before saving. Unsaved details stay in this open view; only shared writing has automatic local draft recovery.
detailsTagsHelp: Separate tags with commas. Up to 12 tags, each at most 40 characters.
detailsTagsLimit: Use at most 40 characters for each tag name.
detailsConflict: Someone changed these fields. Compare both versions, then choose which to keep before saving.
detailsSaved: Record details saved on the host.
detailsSaving: Wait for the record details request to finish before leaving.
draftLibraryHelp: Text saved on this installation remains available when its host is offline or its connection has been removed. Review a draft here, then reconnect to compare it with the shared record.
noDrafts: There are no retained text drafts.
draftReconnect: Reconnect to this record’s host before comparing. Your retained text remains available here.
syncRejected: The host could not accept these changes. Review the latest shared version and your retained text before trying again.
saved: All text changes are saved on the host.
offline: Connection interrupted. Your text is retained locally; Observanda will retry while this view remains open.
offlinePending: Connection interrupted. Saving your latest text locally…
draftFailed: Your latest text could not be saved locally. Keep this view open and retry before leaving.
changed: This writing area was replaced outside the live session. Your text is retained below. Review the latest version before applying it.
denied: Your access changed. Any text not yet sent is retained locally. Reopen the shared view after the owner reviews your access.
restore: Replace shared text with this retained version
keepOpen: Wait for the current text to save, or close the shared view to keep a local draft.
finishForms: Save or discard the record details, research links and structured facts, and post or clear your comment before closing this record.
attemptSaved: Structured fact saved on the host.
attemptDraftHelp: Saving appends this fact to the shared record immediately. Earlier facts stay inspectable; corrections require a reason. This unfinished form stays in this view until saved or cancelled.
attemptFinish: Save or cancel the current preparation, event or assessment before leaving it.
attemptConflict: Another writer amended this fact. Your draft is preserved. Review the latest saved facts above before applying your draft as a new correction, with a reason.
attemptRebase: Apply draft as a correction to the latest fact
attemptRecovered: A previous structured save is retained on this installation. Retry its unchanged request to confirm the host’s result. A confirmed save will not be added twice.
attemptRecoveryFailed: Pending saves could not be checked. Retry recovery before starting another structured fact.
retainedRows: {count} retained rows. Values keep their original spelling; expand a row number to inspect its identity and source positions.
retainedWithheld: This reference is outside your current access grant.
retainedDepth: This reference path has reached its inspection limit. Open the source from its own record to continue.
linksHelp: Link records in the shared books. Methods, comparisons and previous runs retain the exact revision you select. Later edits to those records do not change these references.
linksFinish: Save or cancel the current research link before starting another action.
linkPin: Retain this exact revision for a general relationship
linkInspectFirst: Inspect the selected record to choose its exact revision before saving.
linkReadingSaved: Reading the revision referenced by this research link.
linkReadingCurrent: Reading the current shared revision. An exact link will retain this version when you save.
linkConflict: This link was changed or removed by another writer. Review the shared link before editing it again.
linkStale: The link or selected record changed before saving. Review the latest shared link, or inspect the selected record again, then save.
retryForm: The previous request has not been acknowledged. Restore its original text and retry before submitting different contents.
reader: This access grant allows reading. An administrator can grant editing access.
noGrants: Create an organization and grant access to selected books before hosting them.
stopped: Hosting stopped. Collaborators retain any text not yet sent.
changedWorkspace: The workspace changed. Reopen online collaboration.
recoveryHelp: This text was retained on this installation. Applying it replaces the current writing area for everyone; compare both versions first.
